youtube_description:
I'm camping at Badlands National Park. Check out the beautiful sunset. In the morning a Bison came into the campground to scratch against a post.

There are two campgrounds: Cedar Pass Campground and Sage Creek Campground. Sage Creek Campground is a free, first-come first-serve campground with 22 sites located on Sage Creek Rim Road, an unpaved road that may temporarily close after winter storms and spring rains. 

Subscribe to us here on YouTube for more 360 degree VR video hiking experiences.
